For adapting an app, you end up thinking a lot about the individual pieces of a feature, page flow, attention, and what’s reasonable to adapt. My honest genuine advice would be: if you are unsure where to take your design, take screenshots your app, print them out, and slice them up into the major views/components so you can slide them around on a table.
